definitions.explanation: Acting or existing as distinct units, not together.

examples.japanese: {会計|かいけい}は{別々|べつべつ}でお{願|ねが}いします。
{二人|ふたり}は{別々|べつべつ}の{道|みち}を{歩|ある}いた。
{別々|べつべつ}に{送|おく}ってください。

notes:
{別々|べつべつ} is a reduplication of {別|べつ} (separate; different).

USAGE:
- {別々|べつべつ}の + noun (separate ~)
- {別々|べつべつ}に + verb (separately; do ~ separately)
- {別々|べつべつ}だ (are separate)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {別々|べつべつ}に{暮|く}らす (live separately)
- {別々|べつべつ}に{行動|こうどう}する (act separately)
- {会計|かいけい}は{別々|べつべつ}で (separate checks)
- {別々|べつべつ}の{道|みち} (separate paths)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {別|べつ}に (not particularly; separately)
- {各自|かくじ} (each person; individually)
- それぞれ (each; respectively)

{別々|べつべつ} emphasizes the separateness of two or more things, while それぞれ emphasizes individual differences.
